scope: Conservative presentation of outgoing FAILED contact-bearing rows that also contain a channel index
finding: The actual contact timeline filters persisted rows by contactID, not by absence of channelIndex. A dual-kind row can therefore be displayed in a direct conversation.
repair: Outgoing FAILED contact-bearing rows retain unconfirmed visible and accessible wording even if channelIndex is also present.
The mounted direct conversation registers non-delivered ambiguous contact-bearing keys with the existing historical diagnostic aggregate.
Normal contact-null channel wording, incoming rows and actual DELIVERED state remain unchanged. No DTO field becomes incarnation proof.

source_controls.updated_parameter_family: Every direction, status, contact-presence and channel-presence combination; no DTO mutation
source_controls.new_method_uses: Actual Room contact timeline, actual mounted AppChatsContent, Activity recreation, genuine capability-required producer, visible and accessible labels, registered historical diagnostic read, and enabled composer/retry
source_controls.diagnostic_boundary: A genuine NotEligible read for an ambiguous row is allowed; successful reading is not a positive eligibility, delivery or bound-incarnation assertion.

verification.reason: No local product execution authorized. Exact producer/schema/service/UI composition and hosted exact-head validation remain coordinator-owned.

exclusions: No new row identity binding API
No status, footer-cache, pending-row, send policy or persistence authority changes
No unpublished file-backed reopen artifact included
No whole-WP, runtime, device or hardware acceptance
